## About me

Hello world, welcome to my page! I'm Nastassjia Durand. I'm a current graduate student at Baruch College. Business Analytics major, with a concentration in Data Analytics (graduating May 2027). 

Orginially from Paris, France, I spent a total of 8 years abroad (5 in Oslo, Norway, 1 in Moscow, Russia and a little over 2 years in New York, US). My passion is learning - I love working on different projects, in different industries, going back to school to acquire new skills... All that with one objective - taking messy situations/problems, understanding them, leveraging internal and external knowledge to analyze these problems and offer tailored solutions. I love to navigate ambiguity/grey areas in order to make things work.

#### Professional experiences

I've been working for 5+ years in project management, consulting and strategy, across financial services, digital innovation and sustainability at the following companies: 

- Groupe Mind (events)\
- Allianz Technology (IT transformation and service delivery)\
- PwC (management consulting)\
- BNP Paribas (innovation and strategy)\
- the MTA (public transportation)\

My goal is simple - I want to become a kind of "hybrid", who can both speak technical and non-technical. I started in business, and now I aim to add the technical layer to drive transformation based on real information. I strongly believe that AI can allow us to be more efficient and productive, not by replacing us but by working with it, hand in hand (being an expert first before using the tool). This is where learning how to manipulate data and how to use the technology can be beneficial.

I've already taken the next step in my career, leveraging my background and merging it with data analytics: this summer (2026), I did an internship at the MTA, within the LIRR Strategic Priorities team (Office of the President). The role blended strategy with data insights, to make strategic recommendations based on tangible internal data. I extracted, processed (cleaned), analyzed and translated data into actionable insights for leadership, on how to improve operations.
